channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: St. Lucie County Fire District terminates 3 firefighters, suspends 2 others after hazing investigation
item.description: St. Lucie County Fire District on Saturday released investigative reports detailing allegations of hazing and workplace misconduct that led to the termination of 3 firefighters and the suspension of 2 others. item.title: Wildfire burns 2,500 acres in western Palm Beach County, 30% contained
item.description: A wildfire burning in western Palm Beach County has grown to 2,500 acres and is 30% contained, according to the Florida Forest Service.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9.

item.title: Port St. Lucie brush fire and house fire follow lightning strikes during severe weather
item.description: Lucie County Fire District said crews contained a brush fire near the 1900 block of Castinet Lane after reports that a lightning strike ignited vegetation in a nearby lot.

item.title: Treasure Coast residents report 5 confirmed cyclospora cases since May amid produce contamination concerns
item.description: According to the Florida Department of Health, there have been five confirmed local cases of cyclospora since May, including 2 in Palm Beach County, 2 in St. Lucie County and 1 in Martin County.

item.title: Boynton Beach firefighters rescue dog from raw sewage lift station
item.description: A dog fell roughly 10 to 12 feet into a lift station holding about 2 feet of raw sewage Thursday, prompting a specialized confined space rescue by Boynton Beach Fire Rescue Department.

item.title: Democratic State Rep. Angie Nixon receives September trial date for Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon learned she will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Severe storms bring waterspouts, lightning strikes and fires to Treasure Coast
item.description:
Severe weather Friday afternoon and evening brought waterspouts, lightning strikes and multiple fires across the Treasure Coast and Palm Beach County. Multiple residents in Sebastian sent videos to WPTV showing a large waterspout passing over the Indian River Lagoon Friday afternoon.

item.title: Treasure Coast residents change diets as E. coli and cyclospora outbreaks spread
item.description: Health officials confirmed five local cases of cyclospora since May, including two in St. Lucie County and one in Martin County, prompting residents to avoid lettuce and other greens.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence for in-game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday to prevent use of artificial intelligence for substitutions and pitch calling.

item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 in World Cup semifinal with late comeback goals
item.description: Argentina rallied from a 1-0 deficit with two goals in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 and advance to the World Cup final against Spain.

item.title: British runner Josh Kerr breaks mile world record with 3:42.66 time in London
item.description: Josh Kerr broke the 27-year-old mile world record Saturday, running 3:42.66 at a Diamond League event in London to beat the previous mark of 3:43.13.

item.title: Photographer captured images of Messi bathing infant Yamal 19 years before World Cup final matchup
item.description: Joan Monfort photographed teenage Lionel Messi bathing baby Lamine Yamal in 2007 for a charity calendar. The two will face off Sunday in the World Cup final.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday with Secret Service perimeter and drone monitoring
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies have prepared for two years to secure Sunday's World Cup final in New Jersey with enhanced security measures.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts from Treasure Coast earn top 15 national finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer found their way to the sport through different paths but now compete as one unit on the national stage. item.description: A top truck accident lawyer in Vero Beach shared why documenting evidence at the scene remains one of the most overlooked steps after a collision.
